decisions.reason: The modular plant concept has quantified customer savings well above aspiration, and the growing firm has the slack to keep developing it, so there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
As the flagship multi-model modular line aligned with the firm's strategic direction, it is carried by slack in a growing industry while its results mature.
The new slow-speed shredder line has its own page and appears to succeed the withdrawn single shredder, so it is the firm's chosen solution in this segment and no shortfall has yet been signalled.
The spiral shaft screen line extends the core screening offer and is too new to judge against aspiration, and slack allows the firm to carry it through the early uncertain phase.
